messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High RPM spike for model family \"delta\". Auto-rate-sculpt applied: delta-main RPM -> 60% of baseline. Triggered at 2026-03-16T11:02:09Z.
sam: oncall here — reporting page. are we seeing customer-impacting errors?
maria: looking at dashboards — short completions QPS spiked. 5xx up ~2% and tail latency elevated. affected: delta-main, delta-lite. top tenants: tenant-42 (prod), tenant-omega (dev).
chris: any funcall activity on these flows? if funcall is on it's amplifying backend calls. suggest disabling for delta-main first.
sam: ok. also we should consider raising RPM on delta-lite to handle paid tenant traffic while sculpting delta-main. less risk in bumping a lighter variant.
devops-bot: Runbook: to change per-model RPM -> POST /admin/quota?model=<model>&delta_rpm=<value> (requires infra write token).
alice: i'll take the RPM bump for delta-lite. plan: +1500 RPM (target 2500 RPM) for 15m, monitor. will also keep sculpt on delta-main.
maria: note: cache hit rate is low for tenant-42 (many unique prompts) so batching/caching won't help immediate surge. this looks traffic-pattern driven.
sam: alice, apply and watch latency + 5xx. set automatic rollback if 5xx > 1.5% for 5m.
alice: applied: delta-lite RPM=2500 for 15m (manual carveout). monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood/telemetry/4123456789
chris: disabled funcall on delta-main to reduce noisy downstream calls. command run:
```
curl -X POST https://admin/api/models/delta-main/flags -d '{"funcall": false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
```
maria: early metrics: tenant-42 tail latency down ~30%, 5xx flattened. sculpt still active on delta-main.
sam: good. plan: keep temporary RPM bump 15m, if stable extend to 1h; if errors rise revert. i'll page infra if anything spikes.
chris: tagging support to notify tenant-42 about temporary config changes.
support-bot: Created ticket #support-1234 — notifying account team for tenant-42.
incident-bot: AUTO-RESOLVE check scheduled in 16m.
